detail.title: Synthesis of Causal Memory Foundations
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes evidence regarding the role of persistent physical states as operational memory. It updates the notebook for causal-memory-foundations by integrating findings from real-time systems scheduling and interactive automata learning, while continuing to align thermodynamic models with information-theoretic causal states.
